other.penalty:
Summary: Twelve months imprisonment and / or fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Notes
(i) In relation to an offence committed before paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 22 to the Sentencing Act 2020 comes into force, the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
(ii) On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
